projects.name: Valence Career Agent
projects.desc: Shows job seekers where they stand and what to work on next.
points: Starts from the candidate's goal (finding their next job, navigating their career, improving their AI skills, or preparing for interviews) and adapts the conversation to it.
Imports their résumé, LinkedIn and GitHub for them to review, then asks only what it does not know: career history, projects, pay, timing, location, visa constraints and non-negotiables.

Returns a growth report that coaches two or three answers (what worked, what to add) and sets three growth areas, each with an action, a deliverable and a success signal, all cited from the transcript.
Supports real-time voice and dictation, and lets candidates own their career snapshot and conversation record, with export and deletion.

projects.name: blog2podcast.com
projects.desc: Turns a tech blog post into a podcast: content extraction, script generation and text-to-speech.
points: Crawls the engineering blogs of companies such as Uber, Meta, Netflix and Airbnb on a daily schedule (APScheduler).
Extracts content with several strategies (trafilatura, with a BeautifulSoup fallback) and scores its quality.
Writes a source-grounded summary and a two-speaker script with Ollama Cloud, then voices it with Kokoro on CPU.
First version: GPT-5.2 scripts and OpenAI TTS, with parallel TTS generation in AsyncIO, 3-5x faster for 20-segment podcasts.
Takes user submissions: paste any URL or text and get a podcast in minutes.
Rebuilt the frontend in one day across 28 PRs: auth, player, navigation, library, search and PWA.
Works as a PWA with offline support, lock-screen controls (MediaSession API), iOS safe areas, dvh viewport, WCAG 2.5.8 touch targets, maskable icons and a service worker.
Covers the app with 34 E2E tests across 4 device profiles.
